html:
The Wangan are an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, in the country around today's Clermont and the Belyando River.

Their neighbours were the Jagalingou, Yambina, Barna, Gabalbara and Gayiri. Gold at Clermont and sheep runs on the Peak Downs brought settlers in the early 1860s.

In recent years Wangan and Jagalingou people became known for their long legal fight against the Carmichael coal mine in the Galilee Basin, which was approved over their objections.
sum: The Wangan are an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, in the country around today's Clermont and the Belyando River.
